scope: Polling i2c driver contract for pcf8574 on ToBudOS/STM32F1 HAL. The fixed instance comes from task_requirements; include only HAL/timing operations actually used by the reference implementation and waits inside the main driver.

operations.name: HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit(I2C_HandleTypeDef *, uint16_t addr, uint8_t *data, uint16_t size, uint32_t timeout)

operations.name: HAL_I2C_Master_Receive
operations.signature: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_I2C_Master_Receive(I2C_HandleTypeDef *, uint16_t addr, uint8_t *data, uint16_t size, uint32_t timeout)

semantics.timeouts: bounded per-transfer timeout supplied by caller; value from reference call sites

facts.requirement: Use the fixed ToBudOS i2c polling instance i2c1 (symbol hi2c1), passing the corresponding HAL handle pointer to the reference driver; retain the task-configured bus type and addressing conventions.

Provide the subset of polling HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit/Receive and HAL_I2C_Mem_Read/Write operations actually called by this driver. Use I2C_HandleTypeDef *, the HAL address and memory-address formats, buffers/lengths, HAL_StatusTypeDef returns, and transfer timeouts.
